nodes.speaker: Evan
nodes.text: You turn the handle and step forward into the white light. The apartment fades away. You carry her memory, but you choose to live.
[ENDING 1 — ACCEPTANCE] Thank you for playing 'Why Won't You Leave?'

nodes.speaker: Evan
nodes.text: You let go of the handle and turn back toward the shadows. The apartment reforms around you. Nothing changes. You choose to stay.
[ENDING 2 — THE LOOP] Thank you for playing 'Why Won't You Leave?'
